answer: By the delta of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the ripple of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the mesa re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a factual sentences, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt.
